svg.title: The League of Amazing Programmers — horizontal arced wordmark (checkpoint 2)
svg.desc: Self-contained vector wordmark, variant 2: Trade Gothic Pro Bold (embedded), a dramatically deeper convex bow on "AMAZING" (A/G drooping to roughly 3.25x the rendered height of the compressed center letters Z/I/N -- flat top, no side flare, verticals stay vertical), and "PROGRAMMERS" pulled up to nest in the curve's central valley.

g.text: SMART MINDS · BOLD IDEAS · BRIGHT FUTURES
